title: Base change and composition of smooth morphisms of fixed relative dimension
statement: Let $n,m\geq0$ be integers. Smooth morphisms of relative dimension $n$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] have the following permanence properties. (1) For schemes $X,S,S'$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a smooth morphism $f:X\to S$ of relative dimension $n$, and any $g:S'\to S$, the projection $X\times_SS'\to S'$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is smooth of relative dimension $n$. (2) For schemes $U,X,S$, if $a:U\to X$ is smooth of relative dimension $m$ and $f:X\to S$ is smooth of relative dimension $n$, then $f\circ a$ is smooth of relative dimension $m+n$. Empty schemes are permitted. In particular an etale $a$ has $m=0$.
